page.content:
Unified heavyweight prize after Ibushi's double-title chapter.

How IWGP World Heavyweight Championship connects

  • Character: Kazuchika Okada — Okada's record IWGP reigns defined the Rainmaker era.
  • Character: Hiroshi Tanahashi — Tanahashi's Ace years were built on repeated IWGP heavyweight reigns.
  • Character: Tetsuya Naito — Naito won the IWGP World Heavyweight Championship as LIJ's destrozando Ace.
  • Character: Kota Ibushi — Ibushi's Heavyweight and Intercontinental unification produced the IWGP World title.
  • Character: Will Ospreay — Ospreay held the IWGP World Heavyweight Championship before leaving for AEW.
  • Character: Tatsumi Fujinami — Fujinami's early IWGP Heavyweight reigns preceded the modern world-title lineage.

What is IWGP World Heavyweight Championship?

The IWGP World Heavyweight Championship is New Japan's top title, created when the Heavyweight and Intercontinental belts were unified, then held by Ibushi, Okada, Naito, Shingo, and later champions.

Key threads lead to Kazuchika Okada, Hiroshi Tanahashi, Tetsuya Naito, Kota Ibushi, Will Ospreay and Tatsumi Fujinami.
